verdict.rationale: Free-tier scope is a fair question for a website builder, but the evidence pack never describes a free plan, what its editor allows, or whether collaboration works without a paid seat. The only plan reference (static file hosting on Pro/Enterprise) concerns a different, paid-only feature and says nothing about free-tier design or collaboration.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
